content:
anya: dropped a condensed mock of the Roles rail + 'Add members' slide-over. Trying to tighten vertical space for small screens. https://figma.com/file/abc (preview)
ravi: looks good. Quick: are role names truncated or wrapping? we had complaints about misclicks when names wrap into second line.
mel: prefer truncation + tooltip. Wrapping breaks the selection hit target. Also need a visible focus ring for keyboard nav.
hannah: a11y: tooltips must be reachable via keyboard and SR-friendly. Also chips at 12px fail contrast. recommend >=14px for labels or increase contrast.
anya: ok truncation + tooltip. Will prototype a keyboard-accessible tooltip (tab into role -> press Space for details).
ravi: about SSO: can we show a "Preview affected users" CTA before enabling enforcement? customers want to know who will be denied.
mel: backend: we can return a quick count and a sample list (first 20). Will need a dry-run flag on the API.
hannah: and copy: "Enforcing SSO will block non-SAML logins. Affected: 42 users (preview)" — show that inline in the warning.
anya: I'll add a compact preview modal that hits the dry-run endpoint. Also thinking about making SSO not a single switch but a three-state selector: Off / Optional (SSO encouraged) / Enforced. More explicit than toggle.
ravi: +1 for explicit states. toggles are ambiguous. Also add an inline learn more link about session revocation and MFA impacts.
mel: implementation note: enforcing requires creating a revocation job for existing sessions and a notification email. We'll need a background job and a task id returned to UI. Add UX for showing job progress.
anya: good call. UI will show a small 'migration status' chip in the org header with link to details. Copy suggestion: "Session migration in progress — some users may be asked to reauthenticate."
hannah: for the Roles grid: we need virtualization; but ensure keyboard focus doesn't disappear when rows are recycled. Use an indexed focus model (focus the item by id, not by DOM position).
mel: agreed. we'll expose stable ids and allow focusing by id.
anya: invite flow notes: 1) CSV upload option for bulk adds, 2) disable primary CTA until valid emails parsed, 3) show per-row validation inline, 4) keyboard: hitting Enter on the last field should submit if all valid.
ravi: CSV header requirements should be shown in a tooltip or small help text. Also handle duplicates gracefully.
anya: timeline idea: condensed audit 'sparkline' in the left rail that expands on hover into buckets. For heavy orgs show counts only and 'view' button.
hannah: live region: when filters change announce "Showing X events for period Y". Add role="status" and aria-live="polite" on the container.
mel: QA: please add automated accessibility tests for the tooltip focus, the SSO modal, and the focus trap on the slide-over.
qa-bot: Added checklist: tooltip-focus, aria-live, focus-trap, contrast-chips. Assigned to @hannah, @mel.
dev-bot: New file uploaded by anya — 1717901400 — "roles-rail + ssopolicy preview" :white_check_mark:
anya: thanks. I'll iterate on the mock per feedback and update the Figma frames tonight. If no major objections we'll hand to eng tomorrow morning. :handshake:
